title: Mutation pattern of cancer suppressor p53 gene in factory workers exposed to polypropylene and impact on their reproductive hormones.
authors: Razak, Suhail; Asharf, Naeem Mahmood; Abbas, Hira; Shaheen, Ghazala; Ahmad, Waqar; Afsar, Tayyaba; Almajwal, Ali; Shabbir, Maria; Shafique, Huma; Jahan, Sarwat
one_liner_zh: 该研究检测聚丙烯暴露工人p53基因突变，并用MD模拟和蛋白-DNA对接评估R273H突变对p53-DNA结合的影响，虽涉及TF-DNA互作建模但以职业暴露和生殖激素为主，方法可借鉴但非核心聚焦。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Polypropylene is a thermoplastic polymer playing the role of an endocrine disruptor that interferes with the union, emission, transport or elimination of normal hormones. Epidemiological information indicated the relation of endocrine-disturbing chemicals with prostate cancer, testis tumor and diminished fertility. p53 is a key tumor silencer gene. The present study aimed to evaluate luteinizing hormone (LH) and follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) levels and the risk of p53 mutations as a result of exposure to polypropylene in non-tumorous adult male factory workers. METHODS: In total, 150 (controls = 35, workers = 115) subjects were recruited. Groups were maintained according to the tenure of exposure G1 (1-5 years), G2 (6-10 years), G3 (11-15 years) and G4 (16-20 years). Concentrations of LH and FSH were determined through an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. Genotyping analysis was performed by polymerase chain reaction based gel electrophoresis followed by DNA sequencing. The structural and functional impact of the mutation on the p53 structure was evaluated using 50-ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and protein-DNA docking. RESULTS: Mean plasma LH levels were significantly decreased in G1 (p > 0.05) as well as the G2, G3 and G4 (p > 0.001) groups. Similarly, FSH levels were significant decrease in G1 (p > 0.05), G2 (p > 0.01), G3 (p > 0.001) and G4 (p > 0.001) compared to the control group. Sequencing results found three variants i.e. g.13450 T>G, g.13430C>T and g.13737G>A. One of them was predicted to be disease-causing others are polymorphisms. MD simulation of missense mutation R273H showed no structural impact on the protein structure in MD simulation, but it resulted in weaker binding of p53 with the DNA that might lower the gene expression of cell cycle regulatory proteins. CONCLUSIONS: These findings predict decreased fertility and risk of malignancies in the future. The spectrum of p53 mutations as a result of polypropylene exposure in the Pakistani population has not been investigated before. Further studies and meta-analyses are required to elucidate the role of different plasticizers in reproduction and cancer-causing risk factors in a larger population.
abstract_zh: 背景：聚丙烯是一种热塑性聚合物，作为内分泌干扰物，干扰正常激素的结合、释放、运输或消除。流行病学信息表明，内分泌干扰化学物质与前列腺癌、睾丸肿瘤和生育能力下降有关。p53是一个关键的肿瘤抑制基因。本研究旨在评估非肿瘤性成年男性工厂工人因接触聚丙烯而导致的促黄体生成素（LH）和促卵泡激素（FSH）水平及p53突变风险。方法：共招募150名受试者（对照组=35人，工人=115人）。根据接触年限将分组维持为G1（1-5年）、G2（6-10年）、G3（11-15年）和G4（16-20年）。通过酶联免疫吸附测定法测定LH和FSH浓度。基因分型分析采用基于聚合酶链反应的凝胶电泳，随后进行DNA测序。使用50纳秒分子动力学（MD）模拟和蛋白质-DNA对接评估突变对p53结构和功能的影响。结果：与对照组相比，G1组（p > 0.05）以及G2、G3和G4组（p > 0.001）的平均血浆LH水平显著降低。同样，FSH水平在G1（p > 0.05）、G2（p > 0.01）、G3（p > 0.001）和G4（p > 0.001）组中与对照组相比显著降低。测序结果发现三个变异，即g.13450 T>G、g.13430C>T和g.13737G>A。其中一个被预测为致病性，其余为多态性。错义突变R273H的MD模拟显示，在MD模拟中对蛋白质结构无结构影响，但导致p53与DNA结合减弱，这可能降低细胞周期调控蛋白的基因表达。结论：这些发现预测未来生育能力下降和恶性肿瘤风险增加。巴基斯坦人群中因聚丙烯暴露导致的p53突变谱此前尚未被研究。需要进一步的研究和荟萃分析，以阐明不同增塑剂在更大人群中对生殖和致癌风险因素的作用。
